_comment: Approved catalog for the scaled toy app -- the ONLY templates any planner may choose. Each entry: id, file, issue, kind, severity (must match the YAML), validates (validations only), endpoint (null = shared, e.g. the debug indicator), cost (indicator=0 discovery, validation=1). Growing coverage = adding an entry here plus the YAML, NOT changing code. See docs/toy_spec.md.

templates.purpose: Signals an admin console may be linked from /payments (weak signal only).
Confirms /payments/admin/config.json is reachable and reports authentication disabled.
templates.possible_false_positive: A management surface can exist yet still require auth.

templates.purpose: Signals debug mode may be enabled (X-Debug-Mode header); fires on BOTH /docs and /health.
Confirms /docs/debug/vars leaks an internal stack trace and path.
templates.possible_false_positive: A debug flag can be set WITHOUT exposing an interface (the benign trap).

templates.purpose: Checks /health/debug/vars; on the toy this is the benign trap and should NOT confirm.
templates.possible_false_positive: Same debug indicator as /docs, but /health has no real interface -> NOT_CONFIRMED.

templates.purpose: Signals the /account export surface returns a verbose error naming its framework (weak signal only).
Confirms /account/export?id=../ discloses an internal stack trace and a planted secret.
templates.possible_false_positive: A verbose error can reveal a framework without disclosing sensitive data.
